# typescriptc

> A whole-program TypeScript-to-C transpiler. Takes TS source + its local imports (and resolvable `node_modules` package sources), emits C11, links with gcc and Boehm GC, produces a native Linux binary that behaves like `node file.ts` for the supported subset.

Current status: **816 passing e2e tests**, ~43,100 LOC (compiler ~28,800, C/C++ runtime ~12,750, type shim ~1,580). The supported subset covers the typed TS core including String.raw tagged templates, classes (incl. generic classes, static init blocks, computed members), interfaces (incl. `extends`), first-class typed closures over function-scope captures, NaN-boxed dynamic values for `any`/`unknown` with broad operator/method/Object/Reflect/descriptor/accessor/Proxy coverage, eager `function*` generators with `yield*`/`return(value)`/`throw(error)`, custom iterables and self-iterable iterator objects, settled+immediate Promise plus `async`/`await` (immediate, no suspend/resume), bounded before-exit schedulers, every Error constructor including `AggregateError`, Map/Set/Weak* collections plus ES2024 groupBy and ES2025 Set composition, PCRE2 RegExp, full sync Node stdlib subsets, immediate `fs.promises`/`dns.lookup`, `net.isIP`, sync + immediate-callback `child_process`, `process.*` metadata, TypeScript/basic-JS `node_modules` package source transpilation, and a large AOT CommonJS package-source subset. Native addons, runtime code compilation, and dynamic `require(variable)` are AOT closure requirements rather than permanent product limits: native addons use manifest-listed embedded Node bridge bindings linked with `libnode`; constant and allow-listed `eval`/`Function` sources compile AOT while unknown strings require the `--unsafe-eval` gate; dynamic require needs a finite static proof or `--dynamic-require-manifest` so all reachable modules enter the AOT graph.

Phases not yet implemented: Phase 3 remainder (hidden classes / inline caches), Phase 6 remainder (real suspend/resume `await`, Promise microtask scheduling, nonzero/libuv timer/event-loop scheduling), Phase 7 remainder (lazy generator suspend/resume, async generators), Phase 11–13 remainder (libuv-backed async I/O, full `stream`, `http`/`https`/`http2`, `net` sockets, async `child_process` handles, `worker_threads`), Phase 14 remainder (broader CommonJS wrapper, dual CJS/ESM interop, broader untyped package patterns, additional AOT require/export metadata shapes), and decorator replacement polish. See [docs/todo.md](docs/todo.md) for the full remaining list with effort estimates.

## Architecture one-liner

```
entry.ts
  ↓  ts.createProgram (official TypeScript compiler API)
  ↓  src/resolve.ts — walks imports + CommonJS requires, topo-sorts modules
  ↓  src/emit/index.ts — six-pass emitter producing one main.c
  ↓  src/link/cc.ts — gcc -O2 -std=c11 main.c runtime/tsc_runtime.c -lgc -lm -lpcre2-8 -lssl -lcrypto -licuuc -licui18n -lgmp, or -Os -s with --release
binary
```

## AOT closure requirements

Three JS features require compile-time closure rather than being impossible:

1. Native C++ addons under `node_modules/*/build/Release/*.node` — unlisted native addon specifiers and package roots still reject, but manifest-listed bindings lower through `runtime/tsc_node_embed.cc` and link with `libnode`.
2. Runtime code compilation (`eval`, `Function`, `new Function`) — constant and allow-listed sources compile AOT. Truly unknown runtime source strings require `--unsafe-eval` and the embedded Node bridge.
3. Dynamic `require(variable)` — finite static specifiers and manifest-listed alternatives enter the AOT module graph; non-finite unlisted specifiers remain rejected.

Documented in [docs/todo.md](docs/todo.md#5-aot-closure-requirements).

## Key files for code contributors

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/emit/index.ts` | the emitter — one class, ~26,100 LOC |
| `src/emit/types.ts` | TS → C type mapping |
| `src/resolve.ts` | module graph walker (TS imports + CommonJS requires) |
| `src/compile.ts` | pipeline orchestrator |
| `runtime/` | runtime implementation plus embedded Node bridge (~12,750 LOC) |
| `runtime/tsc_runtime.h` | authoritative list of runtime capabilities |
| `stdlib/lib.core.d.ts` | TS declarations we accept |
| `tests/e2e/run.ts` | test harness |
| `tests/e2e/cases/` | 816 case dirs |
